# Recording Service Product Requirements Document

## Functional Requirements

### Submission capture

- FR1: An operator can record a submission.
- FR2: An operator can list the recorded submissions.

### Export

- FR3: An operator can export the recorded submissions.

## Non-Functional Requirements

### Performance

A submission is recorded within one second of being sent.

### Security

Only an authenticated operator reaches the store.
